evidence_policy: Only committed real events and hash-verified artifacts from this new authorized Attempt. Missing evidence is unavailable/not_run, never inferred as success. No old terminal evidence or fixture outcome can satisfy new real acceptance.

not_found_observation.observed_definition: A later real model request contains the exact committed not_found receipt/status/path/reference in its prompt artifact, with matching source/binding and call identity. A receipt without a subsequent real request does not count. This proves delivery in model input, not hidden reasoning.
not_found_observation.no_applicable_missing_read: not_observed; do not silently pass coverage or buy another round

patch.successful_application_definition: Real OCI apply_patch succeeded, approved path only, resulting persisted snapshot/diff and source hash verified. A model patch proposal or self summary does not count.

latest_source_verify.pass_definition: All four exact approved commands pass under the latest frozen source; source hashes and exported diff/attempt/contract provenance agree. Source changes invalidate earlier Verify.

independent_review.pass_definition: Verified independent ReviewRun consumes this Attempt latest diff and Verify evidence with valid invocation and hashes. Coder finish/self summary cannot satisfy Review. Stop before human final acceptance.

blocker_and_recovery.rule: Preserve true executed receipts and spending. Safe terminal is not automatically resumed. No new paid round, retry outside existing bounds, budget refund or old authority reuse.

budget_and_legacy.rule: All original per-run/Review caps retained. Plan11/12/13/14 histories, spending, approvals and holds immutable. Only fresh one-time consent can create authority for Plan15. No budget reset/refund/extra paid round. Push/PR/comments/publication forbidden.

coding_observation_metrics.purpose: Observe the new real run without adding calls, tokens, reads or acceptance retries.
coding_observation_metrics.model_calls: Count hash-bound model_started/request/response events for this Attempt by phase; distinguish started, completed, rejected, failed and unknown. Report independent Review invocation/attempt counts separately. Preserve actual usage and charged/reserved usage separately.
coding_observation_metrics.effective_reads: Per source_hash/file_content_hash, compute unique newly delivered UTF8 byte intervals from committed successful read receipts and the subsequent REAL request prompt. Report tool-observed and model-input-delivered bytes separately; not_found, reused bytes and fixture results do not count as new source bytes.
coding_observation_metrics.repeated_reads: Report requested/executed/reused duplicate ranges and overlapping bytes by source/content/range, including changed max_bytes returning identical bytes. Report same-offset requests separately. Never treat a changed max_bytes alone as progress.
coding_observation_metrics.first_patch_round: One-based real Coding request ordinal of first patch proposal and first successful OCI application, separately; include original response/call/receipt hashes and source before/after. No patch => null/not_observed, never a fixture ordinal.
coding_observation_metrics.prompt_inline_source_coverage: For EACH actual request, record full prompt artifact, native bound, per-file available/inline UTF8 byte intervals, truncation/next_offset and raw source references. Separate tool-returned bytes from visible inline bytes and unique cumulative delivered bytes. Check frozen Issue/Plan references remain recoverable; no assumed memory between requests.
coding_observation_metrics.artifact_pagination_recovery: Record issued source-page/Plan Artifact hash, requested offset/max_bytes, actual bytes and next_offset, receipt, next REAL model prompt inclusion, continuity and reconstructed SHA256. Distinguish raw page completion from full-file completion; file tails need authorized read_file. No recovery requested => not_observed.
coding_observation_metrics.output_capacity_and_billing: Retain original batch/proof/certificate hashes, v3 OCI binding, all call IDs/order, certificate upper bound and remaining bytes, exact final result/raw-page/metadata charges, dedup and unknown/not-dispatched prefix. Recompute charges from immutable bytes under unchanged 500000 ceiling.
coding_observation_metrics.Verify: All four exact approved commands on the latest modified source, with source/diff/test/contract hashes and real outcomes. Baseline, fixtures or an older source do not satisfy Verify.
coding_observation_metrics.independent_Review: Independent ReviewRun and invocation bound to this Attempt's latest diff/Verify/tests, actual reviewer identity, verdict/findings and usage; coder finish cannot substitute. Stop at Human Acceptance.
coding_observation_metrics.missing_or_unavailable: Use not_run/not_observed/unavailable with null values and reason; never infer success, hidden reasoning or buy extra coverage. All counters initially refer only to the unexecuted Plan15.

fixture_and_platform_disclosure: Offline checks and macOS arm64/OrbStack OCI evidence are prerequisites only. Native Linux amd64 remains not_run; HR4/HR5 remain open.
